notes.title: Major update (S2) + new season release!
notes.notes:
Yesterday I updated the first season. Today it's the turn for the second one!
The patch contains both fixes for minor issues (wrongly compressed pictures, typos in the text, etc.) and major text fixes, especially related to the economic system.

This may not seem like a big deal, but still half of the point of this game is text. Therefore, some things needed more detail. After all, the world seems much more alive when it has internal logic, right?


And I'm happy to report that the NEW SEASON came out the other day. Refresh your memories by playing the previous seasons, or start with the new one right away, it's up to you =)
It's already available on Steam. 
And hope you like it!

I'll be glad to get any feedback, comments and suggestions. Feel free to share them with me!
All the best and see you soon!
